doc: Registered-deck witness cards of the clause grammar (design doc 2026-09-29, section 18.1). Each row names a card, a face, a host selector and the expected spec chain as the design doc states it, in the shape language of tests/test_effect_grammar_pool_invariants.py (_match_host). A row with known_gap names the earlier-layer refusal (a leaf or L1-L4 refusal) that keeps the card from its expected chain today: the test pins it as a strict xfail, so the row flips to a pass, and must lose its known_gap, the day the refusal is fixed. Card names live only here.
